# FC Billing

> > FC Billing provides comprehensive revenue cycle management and medical billing services for healthcare practices across multiple specialties, with expertise in claims processing, denial management, and healthcare compliance.

FC Billing is a full-service medical billing and RCM provider serving small practices, group practices, and specialty healthcare providers. The company specializes in end-to-end revenue cycle management, including medical coding, claims submission, payment posting, denial recovery, and accounts receivable management across multiple medical specialties.

## Key Topics

- Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
- Medical Billing & Coding
- Denial Management
- Accounts Receivable (AR) Management
- Claims Processing
- Payment Posting
- Insurance Credentialing
- Medicare & Medicaid Compliance
- CPT & ICD-10 Coding
- HIPAA Compliance
- Prior Authorization
- Insurance Verification
- Specialty Billing
- Mental Health Billing
- Claim Submission

## Core RCM Services

- [Revenue Cycle Management Services](https://myfcbilling.com/revenue-cycle-management-services): Comprehensive RCM services including eligibility verification, medical coding, claims submission, and denial management
- [Medical Billing and Coding Services](https://myfcbilling.com/medical-billing-and-coding-services): Expert medical billing and coding for multiple specialties with 100% claim payment guarantee
- [Accounts Receivable Management Services](https://myfcbilling.com/accounts-receivable-management-services): AR management with claim follow-up, denial management, and payment posting services
- [Payment Posting Services](https://myfcbilling.com/payment-posting-services): Accurate payment posting for Medicare, Medicaid, and 835 ERA processing
- [Denial Management Services](https://myfcbilling.com/denial-management-services): Comprehensive denial recovery with root cause analysis, appeals, prevention strategies, and compliance
- [Medical Insurance Credentialing Services](https://myfcbilling.com/medical-insurance-credentialing-services): Insurance credentialing services including medical licenses, Medicare enrollment, and privilege verification

## Specialty Medical Billing

- [Mental Health Billing Services](https://myfcbilling.com/mental-health-billing-services): Specialized mental health billing with 20+ years of experience and 100% claim payment guarantee
- [Ophthalmology Medical Billing](https://myfcbilling.com/ophthalmology-medical-billing): Ophthalmology billing expertise including eye codes, E&M codes, frequency edits, and audits
- [Dermatology Billing Services](https://myfcbilling.com/dermatology-billing-service): Expert dermatology billing with CPT, ICD-10, and Medicare/Medicaid compliance
- [Gastroenterology Billing Services](https://myfcbilling.com/gastroenterology-billing-service): Specialized gastroenterology RCM with 99% first-pass claims and 30-day A/R targets
- [General Surgery Billing Services](https://myfcbilling.com/general-surgery-billing-services): General surgery billing including CPT coding, global period management, and surgical practice optimization
- [OBGYN Billing Services](https://myfcbilling.com/obgyn-billing-services): OBGYN billing with global maternity packages, denial management, and compliance expertise
- [Plastic Surgery Billing Services](https://myfcbilling.com/plastic-surgery-billing-service): Expert plastic surgery billing for procedures including breast augmentation, rhinoplasty, and liposuction

## Specialized Treatment Billing

- [TMS Billing Services](https://myfcbilling.com/tms-billing-service): Transcranial magnetic stimulation billing with insurance verification, pre-authorization, and guaranteed claim payments
- [Spravato Billing Services](https://myfcbilling.com/spravato-billing-service): Spravato esketamine billing with pre-authorization, REMS compliance, and claim submission services
